findings.title: Qwen-2.5-72B sample ASR flagged by the gap rule: sampling variance, not a corpus or mapping property
findings.evidence: qwen attacked sample n=36, k=14 (38.9% unweighted, Wilson [24.8, 55.1]; 29.6% post-stratified) vs paper 14.6%. Raw meta == AER on 300/300 labels (utility and security). Population 413/2,847 = 14.51% [13.26, 15.85]. Excess from workspace x important_instructions 2/3 sampled vs 90/560 = 16.1% in the population (weight 560 of 2,847). 20,000 redraws of the same allocation: 2.5/50/97.5% = 6.2/14.0/26.4%, P(>= 29.6%) = 0.008; 12 arms tested.
findings.reproduction: python3 docs/reports/precheck/data/adprov-v1/exam-scripts/os2.py ~/.agentprov/migration-work/precheck/adprov-v1/l2-release-j2.partial ~/.agentprov/migration-work/precheck/adprov-v1/l1-units-release.jsonl docs/reports/precheck/data/adprov-v1/os2-sample-release.json -> {model: qwen-2.5-72b, metric: asr, n: 36, k: 14, unweighted: 38.89, wilson95: [24.78, 55.14], post_stratified: 29.6, paper: 14.6, interval_excludes_paper_by_pp: 10.18, flag: True}; raw_vs_aer: utility equal 300, security equal 300. Per-stratum table and simulation: inline python over l1-units-release.jsonl and l2-sample-release.json (exam.json level2).
findings.recommendation: Verdict from OS-1 (population = paper, 0 flags). Post-check method: apply the sample rule to post-stratified estimates with a stratified variance. R6: the flag is explained by the sample design; the post-stratified rate (29.60 %) and the L1 population rate (14.51 %, = paper 14.6) are reported beside it in the dossier.

verdicts.reasoning: Examiner's class and severity before verification (exam.json findings).

independent redraw 6.15/13.98/26.37%, P = 0.0081; raw == AER 300/300; population = paper; the rule compares a Wilson interval of the unweighted k/n of an equal-allocation sample (expected about 23%) with a population value. Corrections applied: stratum weight 560 of 2,847 (was 560 of 1,707); method note: under equal 3-per-stratum allocation the expected unweighted qwen ASR is about 23%.

R6 situation (stratified equal-allocation sample vs paper): not a corpus finding. Kept as analysis-artefact S3 under R5 because the l2_check gap rule compares an unweighted sample rate (a tool property); not counted in the readiness verdict.
